project.name: Customer Churn Prediction Accelerator
bullets: Built a reusable churn prediction accelerator on Databricks, with PySpark pipelines preparing customer data and Random Forest and XGBoost models ranking at-risk accounts for retention teams.
Evaluated models with cross-validation and business-facing lift reports, then deployed them to Azure through Docker, the MLflow model registry and a FastAPI scoring endpoint with Git-based CI.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Data Science & Machine Learning Engineering Consultant role in Accenture's AI & Data team. Much of my career has been client-facing: taking a business problem, shaping it into a data solution and building it through to production. That mix of advising and building is the work I enjoy most.

Accenture's Strategy & Consulting practice works with some of the largest organisations in the Netherlands on their data platforms and AI, which gives the variety of problems I am looking for. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Amsterdam together and settle there long term.

At Viavi I delivered POCs and consulting for 15+ clients, which grew POC and mentoring revenue by 11%, and prototyped 15+ AI applications, with 7 reaching production or paid work. On the engineering side, I built SQL and PySpark pipelines that cut manual reporting effort by 95%. I would bring that same end-to-end delivery to your clients.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Working with teachers taught me to listen first and build only what people will really use, the same habit I bring to clients. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
